title: SIDEPANEL-HUDPANEL-REFACTOR
description: Refactor panels to introduce SidePanel and HudPanel components. SidePanel is left/right with scrollable tabs. HudPanel is center. Replace dropdown toggles with simple panel toggles. Apps register tabs to panels.
summary: Refactored Design HUD panel layout and visibility by adding real hud/stats sections, i18n labels, and stricter HUD layout/tree assertions in existing sketchpad test file.
